kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
wire.summary: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

wire.title: Head of Justice Department office on Civil Rights resigns
wire.summary: The head of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division, Harmeet Dhillon, is out after 18 tumultuous months in charge.

wire.title: Discursive Verses: Is 'Spend Dat' the best financial indicator of America's grift economy?
wire.summary: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: How Yung Miami's summer bop became a sweeping indictment.

wire.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
wire.summary: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

wire.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
wire.summary: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

wire.title: Teens worldwide aren't getting enough exercise -- especially girls
wire.summary: A new study looks at the recommended amount of daily exercise for adolescents — and how few are getting it.

wire.title: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
wire.summary: Democrats have regained control of Congress. They have a long list of investigations into Trump planned. And, not all races have been called. Here's a look at how they could affect the Dems' majority.

wire.title: After sweeping midterm wins, here's what Democrats hope to get done in the majority
wire.summary: Democrats ran on lowering costs and stamping out corruption. Now that they've won, party leaders will have to unite a sometimes fractious caucus to fulfill those pledges.

wire.title: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats must end Iran war, hold Trump accountable. But how?
wire.summary: Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand spoke with Morning Edition about Democrats' priorities, from lowering costs to ending the Iran war. But questions remain about how they'll deliver.

wire.title: Trump's arch is on the verge of federal approval. But a judge could block construction
wire.summary: A federal panel will meet to consider the arch for final approval on Thursday, and the government said it may begin construction later that same day. Critics hope a judge will intervene last-minute.

wire.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
wire.summary: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

wire.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
wire.summary: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

wire.title: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row
wire.summary: California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates in the US.

wire.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
wire.summary: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

wire.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
wire.summary: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

wire.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
wire.summary: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.
